entries.145f39b9915c99c6: Because it operates businesses itself, it can deeply understand on-site decision logic and operational workflows and feed them directly back into its AI, which is its advantage. In healthcare, finance and real estate, where laws, regulations and business practices are complex, general-purpose generative AI is difficult to substitute, and the structure in which accuracy improves the more AI is used leads to a low churn rate and high switching costs. Its customer network built through an alliance with Sony Group, its major shareholder, also forms part of the foundation of its business.

entries.9b3ef17ac79516d9: SRE Holdings Corporation is the holding company, and the group consists of 15 consolidated subsidiaries, including SRE AI Partners Inc. and Medikkusu Co., Ltd. Headquartered in Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo, the company had 533 consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026.
entries.a579ca15d36fc37c: This business provides industry-specialized AI cloud services and BPaaS solutions for the real estate, healthcare and finance fields. Centered on a cycle that feeds data obtained from business operations back into AI to improve accuracy, it is described as an area driving medium-term growth. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,507 million.

entries.b33116d176b60ed8: A structure that circulates between the two businesses is the core of its strategy. It aims to deepen, along with expanding target areas, a cycle in which property data and expert judgment logic accumulated in on-site operations of the Life & Property Solutions Business are refined by the AI Cloud & Consulting Business into AI clouds and BPaaS for external sale, and sharpened AI is returned to on-site operations to raise productivity. In the Life & Property Solutions Business, it is also building stock earnings by expanding assets under management in asset management.
